body: Verified the approved LLM default-model deletion guard end to end. The backend repository rejects deletion of the default model and the API preserves semantic conflict 409/4092. The active LlmModelsView disables the default row delete action, never opens confirmation or calls DELETE for it, and requires confirmation before deleting a non-default row. Added the missing active-view regression test. Backend target: 1 passed. Frontend targets: 2 files/6 tests. Full frontend baseline after approved retired-test cleanup: 99 files/857 tests. vue-tsc and git diff check exited 0.
